candidates.title: Tesla Q3 2026: $28.0B revenue, 75% FSD attach, Semi volume production started
candidates.whyItMightMatter: In-line revenue and a 2.6% operating margin, with the letter claiming Semi volume production and a North America FSD attach rate above 75%

candidates.title: Cybercab customer deliveries aimed at end of 2026, but most stay Tesla-owned
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Moravy wants outside Cybercab deliveries this year while Musk says transport-as-a-service stays Tesla-owned; Ashok put unsupervised FSD in customer cars in Q2 2027

candidates.title: Cybercab line is building faster than Tesla can deploy the cars
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Moravy says the Texas line is ahead of fleet deployment and is not run every day, with a stated 10-second cycle goal

candidates.title: Cybercab 4680 pack leaves room for a later LFP swap
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Current pack is nickel 4680 with spare volume for lower-density LFP; Texas records cited 544 Cybercabs versus 507 Model Y robotaxis

candidates.title: Latvia becomes the 10th EU country to recognize Tesla Assisted Driving
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Another national recognition of the Dutch provisional approval; still supervised Level 2, and the EU-wide vote is still expected in December

candidates.title: Italy backs an EU-wide Tesla Assisted Driving vote, not a national approval
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Salvini supports a swift EU decision after talking with Musk, but Italy has not cleared the feature for its own roads

candidates.title: Houston Robotaxi geofence expands; Cybercab public rides still Austin-only
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Unsupervised Model Y area in Houston grew, while the article still limits public Cybercab service to Austin and points Dallas Cybercab rides to November

candidates.title: Robotaxi hours move from midnight to 2 a.m.
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Official account now lists 6 a.m. to 2 a.m., but Tesla did not say which cities or whether only Cybercab gets the extra hours

candidates.title: Tesla launches a Robotaxi safety site and says four more cities are coming
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Oracle says a public safety site now covers Model Y robotaxis and Cybercabs and that Tesla announced four additional city launches

candidates.title: FSD v14.3.13 rolls wider on 2026.38.5.11 for HW4 and HW3 Lite
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Point release after last week's v14.3.12 wave; still the v14 line, not v15

candidates.title: Ashok says Tesla is building its own AI maps before FSD v15
candidates.whyItMightMatter: On the Q3 call he said in-house AI navigation should be ready as v15 reaches customers, replacing reliance on outside map data

candidates.title: Fremont Optimus line called production-quality; outside deliveries end of next year
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Letter claims the first production-quality bots and a 10,000–20,000 robot academy; external delivery is still end of next year and hands remain unsolved

candidates.title: Musk says Optimus ordering is not opening in December
candidates.whyItMightMatter: One-word denial of a same-day reservation rumor; Tesla still has no public order page

candidates.title: Q3 letter targets 400 MW of SI training compute by year-end
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Company target for training compute behind vehicle and Optimus autonomy, separate from last week's Samsung Taylor yield notes

candidates.title: Q3 letter says Austin Fab equipment commissioning starts in 2027
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Tesla's own date for starting tool commissioning at the Austin fab, against last week's reports that an EUV tool could sit idle
